in_vitro_detail: Cell uptake of 177Lu-Palm-3PRGD2 and 177Lu-3PRGD2 in integrin avb3/avb5-positive U87MG glioma cells at 1, 4 and 24 h; competition binding assays on 10^5 U87MG cells in filter multiscreen DV plates against increasing concentrations of unlabeled 3PRGD2, with and without human serum albumin, giving IC50 values; n-octanol/PBS distribution coefficient (logPO/W) determination in a cell-free two-phase system; Western blotting for integrin expression.

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 2A (KM mice); Fig. S10 (C57BL/6 mice); Fig. 5A,B (tissue time-activity curves)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Blood clearance curves of 177Lu-Palm-3PRGD2, 177Lu-3PRGD2, and 177Lu-Palm performed in KM mice.
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 2A plots blood radioactivity (%IA/g) against time after a single intravenous dose and is the source of the two-phase decay half-lives in Table 2. Fig. 5A and 5B are time-activity curves for tumour and major organs derived from the biodistribution study.

bioanalytical_method: Gamma counting of 177Lu radioactivity in weighed blood, tissue and cell samples with a gamma-counter, expressed as %IA/g; radio-HPLC (Agilent 1260 with radioactive detector, C18 column) for radiochemical purity and for in vivo stability in urine; small-animal SPECT/CT (Mediso) for imaging
bioanalytical_quote: Blood samples obtained from the canthus vein were collected at different time points post injection (p.i.), weighed, and evaluated using a g-counter. The results are presented as the percentage injected activity per gram (%IA/g).
notes: The header line of the source file reads 'PMID: ?'; the PMID field is set to the assigned value 35890224. No Cmax or tmax is reported for any agent: dosing was intravenous and blood data are expressed as %IA/g versus time without a reported peak parameter. No absorption half-life and no rate constant is reported anywhere, so nothing was converted. The body reports a two-phase decay fit with half-lives labelled T1/2alpha and T1/2beta but never uses the words 'distribution' or 'elimination' for those phases; half_life_phase is therefore recorded as terminal/beta (the literal label) and half_life_elimination carries the T1/2beta value with an explicit caveat. Alpha-phase values (177Lu-Palm-3PRGD2 4.49 min, 177Lu-3PRGD2 1.94 min, 177Lu-Palm 3.33 min in KM mice; 2.08 and 1.06 min in C57BL/6 mice) are deliberately kept out of the headline half_life field. Blood clearance was measured in normal female KM mice while biodistribution and therapy used female C57BL/6 MC38 tumour-bearing mice; the Discussion flags this strain mismatch as a study limitation. Human serum albumin was added to one in vitro competition binding condition (IC50 5.82 ± 1.29 nM with HSA) but was not dosed and is not listed as an agent. The therapy control is described as 'saline' in Methods 2.11 but as 'PBS (as a control)' in the Figure 5 legend; both wordings are recorded. The effective absorbed human dose of 4.04 x 10-2 mSv/MBq is an OLINDA dosimetry estimate extrapolated from mouse biodistribution, not a measured PK parameter.
